prtznstg.baseName: Walplus 300 LEDs Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
prtznstg.variantName: Walplus 300 LEDs Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
prtznstg.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree with LED Light brings the festive joy directly to your home or outside area. Its trendy cone shape is all about elegance and simplicity, making it the perfect focal point for your indoor or outdoor holiday decorations. With warm LED lights creating a lovely ambiance, this tree turns your living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland while keeping things stylish and minimalist. Whether it’s for parties or quiet evenings in, its gentle glow and modern look will fit right in. Complete Set: The Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree comes with beautiful warm white LED decorative string lights that give you a heartwarming festive glow. These energy-efficient lights sparkle without the hassle of tangling wires, so you can set up quickly and easily. Durability and Style: Made with PVC, this tree is UV resistant, keeping its vibrant look during the holiday season even in the sun. The strong steel frame makes it sturdy while the modern, cone shape blends well with today’s home decor. Versatile Placement: Great for both indoor and outdoor use, this tree can be the star of your living room or add charm to your garden or terrace. Its good looks and practical design make it easy to fit into various settings, boosting the Christmas spirit wherever it goes. Efficient Power Options: With its USB-powered lights, this tree offers convenience by connecting to any power source with a standard 5V USB connector (not included). You can easily place the tree wherever it looks best. Assembly and Care: Two people are needed for assembly, just follow the manufacturer’s instructions to set it up without a hitch. Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 115 cm Stand size: 40 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips Number of PVC tips: 465 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

grn77ndj.baseName: Charles Bentley 180cm Artificial Berry Christmas Garland - White
grn77ndj.variantName: Charles Bentley 180cm Artificial Berry Christmas Garland - White
grn77ndj.sourceDescription: Our 180cm White Berry Christmas Garland is a calmer, more contemporary take on festive greenery. Dressed in clusters of delicate white berries, it brings a quiet refined elegance – ideal for a Christmas scheme that feels fresh understated and considered. Draped over a fireplace mantel, wound around a staircase banister, or framing a doorway, this garland brings a calm, all-white palette that works across a wide range of festive styling – it sits beautifully alongside silver, gold, blush, and copper, and holds its own in a more minimal or scandi scheme. The berry clusters add texture and detail without introducing colour, keeping the overall look clean and cohesive. At 180cm long with a pliable, shapeable construction, it's as easy to style as it is to store – a Christmas classic that will earn its place in your Christmas display year after year. Ideal for: Fireplace mantels, staircase banisters, doorways, window ledges, festive tablescapes, and contemporary Christmas displays. Please Note: For indoor use only. Keep away from open flame and heat sources. Features: • Clusters of white berries – a contemporary elegant Christmas look for any room • Natutral white palette pairs beautifully with any festive colour scheme • Pliable branches are easy to shape and hold their position without additional fixings • Durable plastic construction – no shedding no fading no mess • Lightweight and straightforward to handle – no tools or fixings required • Compact to store – folds flat for easy off-season storage Includes: • 1x White Berry Christmas Garland Materials: • Plastic (white berries and detailing) Dimensions: H25, W25, D180cm Warning: for indoor decorative use only. Keep away from open flames, heat sources and ignition sources. Do not allow children or pets to play with the garland. Secure it so it cannot fall or create a trip or entanglement hazard. Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ
